death.attack.gmm.leech_rip: %1$s tore a leech off and bled out
death.attack.gmm.leech_rip.player: %1$s tore a leech off and bled out while fighting %2$s
death.attack.gmm.fire_breath: %1$s was burned to ash by %2$s's breath
